title: Petal Pixie (unl-076-219) sitting alone in player-1's base displays an 'Effective Might' badge of 3 (printed Might 2) in both the BEFORE and AFTER screenshots. No unit with [Temporary] exists anywhere, and Petal Pixie is not at a battlefield, so its Might should be 2. Root cause: the rules-text parser turns 'I have +1 [Might] for each of your units with [Temporary] at my battlefield' into a static
expected: Ran parseAbilities on Petal Pixie's rulesText: output is {type:"modify-might", amount:1, per:"of your units with [Temporary] at my battlefield", target:"self"} — static-parser.ts:648-681 falls through to the flat `amount` + opaque `per` branch because parseForEachQualifier (static-parser.ts:36-60) only recognizes two qualifiers. Engine applyStaticEffect (packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/static-abilities.ts:566-570, 630-635) treats numeric amount as a flat bonus and never reads `per`; getAllBoardCards (line 58) includes base cards so it applies in base too. Card unl/petal-pixie.ts has no explicit abilities so enrich-cards.ts uses the parser. Screenshot 25.png shows the "3" badge on Petal Pixie alone in base.
